g.text: Two-year aged Himalayan extra-long Basmati and pasture mutton layered in a heavy copper degh,
hermetically sealed with whole-wheat dough. Steamed over embers with Meetha Ittar, kewra and saffron.
Accompaniment: Burani Garlic Raita & Mirchi Ka Salan
Whole tender spring chicken slow-braised in an opulent almond, melon seed and saffron jus,
stuffed with spiced minced meat, golden sultanas and whole roasted pine nuts.
Zero steam escapes the copper degh until it arrives at your table.
The moment the golden crust is cut open with an antique dagger, a rich cloud of Kashmiri
saffron and rose ittar envelops the room in pure sensory splendour.
Whole black urad lentils slow-simmered overnight over smouldering charcoal embers with sun-ripened
San Marzano tomatoes, garlic, white churned cow butter and pure heavy cream. Velvety, smoky, iconic.
Served with Butter Garlic Naan & Laccha Paratha
Prime marrow shanks simmered from twilight to dawn with 32 medicinal herbs and roghan glaze,
served with bone marrow reduction, fresh ginger matchsticks and hot green chillies.
Tempranillo & Shiraz aged 15 months in French oak barrels. Dark cherry, roasted cacao and spice.
Full-bodied, structured ripe cassis and black pepper pairing effortlessly with Nalli Nihari.
Chilled full-cream milk steeped with soaked almonds, melon seeds, poppy seeds, and Damascus rose water.
